text:
maria-sales: Hey team — Acme's procurement asked for a single-page data flow diagram + an export of all subprocessors and which regions we store logs/embeddings in. POC kicks off next Tue, they want these for the vendor review. Can someone own a short bundle (diagram + CSV) today? :wave:
akshay-ps: I can take the diagram and CSV. Quick Q: do we share the full subprocessors list or a redacted/role-based view for presales? they specifically called out 'where embeddings live' and retention for logs. :thinking_face:
lee-security: Short answers before I get into details: hosted API -> customer can pin data region for data plane; control plane metadata lives in our US control plane by default. Private (VPC/on-prem) option keeps everything in-customer-network. We support customer-managed KMS for Private and Dedicated. Subprocessors we disclose in the DPA; for presales we usually provide the full list in the vendor form but can redact contact details.
lee-security: Quick checklist i'll add to the bundle: - Data plane (inputs/outputs, embeddings): persisted only in chosen region (e.g., ap-southeast-1) unless customer opts into cross-region backups. - Control plane (routing, billing metadata): multiregion but primary in us-west-2. - Logs/metrics: aggregated to Datadog (EU/US), retention configurable via console. - Model artifacts: from model catalog (open weights) cached on infra in region. - Encryption: in-transit TLS + at-rest AES-256; customer KMS supported.
nina-eng: Pushing a compact ASCII dataflow for presales doc (replace with SVG in bundle):
```
Client -> [API Gateway - region pinning]
            |
            v
      [Inference Runtime (data plane) - region: ap-southeast-1]
            |            \n            |             -> [KV Cache - regional]
            v
      [Storage: embeddings blob (S3/GCS) - region]
            |
            v
      [Optional: Cross-region backup (disabled by default)]

Control Plane (metadata, routing) -> [Control DB - primary us-west-2]
Monitoring -> [Datadog | Sentry]
Secrets -> [KMS (customer-managed optional)]
```
redwood-deploy-bot: generated artifact: https://internal.redwood/docs/acme/dataflow-1778204567.svg (expires in 7d) :white_check_mark:
akshay-ps: Nice diagram. I also exported subprocessors.csv draft: aws, gcp, cloudflare, datadog, sentry, stripe (billing), HashiCorp Vault (secrets in some customers), Snyk. Jordan, do we need legal OK before I send that to the buyer? :eyes:
jordan-legal: Please include our standard DPA + subprocessors appendix. For presales we can send the CSV list but mark the DPA as the source of truth for contractual obligations. Also call out the Private option in the cover note — customers often escalate to Private for residency/regulatory blockers. I'll review the CSV in 30m.
maria-sales: Great — plan: akshay will attach diagram + CSV to the presales packet, jordan will add DPA blurb, lee will add the short security checklist and notes about KMS and log retention. I'll send to Acme's buyer after your signoffs. Can we aim to have signed-off package by EOD? :thumbsup:
lee-security: Acked. I'll add a one-paragraph note about control-plane metadata residency and a line on our fallback policy (model variant fallback doesn't move data to a different region).
jordan-legal: Reviewed CSV, removed employee emails and added DPA link + effective dates. akshay send final to me for a last pass before outbound.
akshay-ps: Will upload final bundle to the presales drive and ping here when ready. ETA 2h.
maria-sales: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll prep the POC SOW with region pin set to ap-southeast-1 and call out log retention options. If Acme asks about SOC2/STIGs i can attach the audit pack but they haven't asked yet. :slightly_smiling_face:
